import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MODULUS_NUM = 1000000007L;

    static class HashFunc {
        static long splitmix64(long x) {
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >> 31);
        }

        static long get_seed() {
            return splitmix64(System.nanoTime() + new Random().nextLong());
        }

        long seed;

        HashFunc() {
            this.seed = splitmix64(System.nanoTime() + new Random().nextLong());
        }

        long operator(long x) {
            return splitmix64(x ^ seed);
        }
    }

    static class ModNumberType {
        int v;

        ModNumberType(long val_in) {
            val_in %= MODULUS_NUM;
            if (val_in < 0) val_in += MODULUS_NUM;
            v = (int) val_in;
        }

        static int extended_gcd(int a, int m, int[] xy) {
            if (m == 0) {
                xy[0] = 1; xy[1] = 0;
                return a;
            }
            int[] yx = new int[2];
            int g = extended_gcd(m, a % m, yx);
            int y = yx[0], x = yx[1];
            xy[0] = yx[0];
            xy[1] = y - (a / m) * x;
            return g;
        }

        static int mod_inverse(int a) {
            int[] xy = new int[2];
            extended_gcd(a, (int)MODULUS_NUM, xy);
            int x = xy[0];
            return (x % (int)MODULUS_NUM + (int)MODULUS_NUM) % (int)MODULUS_NUM;
        }

        ModNumberType add(ModNumberType other) {
            int res = v + other.v;
            if (res >= MODULUS_NUM) res -= (int)MODULUS_NUM;
            return new ModNumberType(res);
        }

        ModNumberType subtract(ModNumberType other) {
            int res = v - other.v;
            if (res < 0) res += (int)MODULUS_NUM;
            return new ModNumberType(res);
        }

        ModNumberType multiply(ModNumberType other) {
            long res = ((long) v * other.v) % MODULUS_NUM;
            return new ModNumberType(res);
        }

        ModNumberType divide(ModNumberType other) {
            return multiply(new ModNumberType(mod_inverse(other.v)));
        }

        ModNumberType pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            ModNumberType res = new ModNumberType(1);
            ModNumberType base = new ModNumberType(v);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) res = res.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        ModNumberType[][] prob = new ModNumberType[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                prob[i][j] = new ModNumberType(p).divide(new ModNumberType(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> count_mask = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            count_mask.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] index_map = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(index_map, -1);
        for (int msk = 0; msk < (1 << N); msk++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(msk);
            index_map[msk] = count_mask.get(c).size();
            count_mask.get(c).add(msk);
        }

        Map<Long, ModNumberType> state_map = new HashMap<>();
        long initial_mask = 1L << index_map[0];
        state_map.put(initial_mask, new ModNumberType(1));

        for (int left_idx = 0; left_idx < N; left_idx++) {
            Map<Long, ModNumberType> new_state_map = new HashMap<>();
            ModNumberType[] prod_mask = new ModNumberType[1 << N];
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
                prod_mask[mask] = new ModNumberType(1);
                for (int col = 0; col < N; col++) {
                    if (((mask >> col) & 1) != 0)
                        prod_mask[mask] = prod_mask[mask].multiply(prob[left_idx][col]);
                    else
                        prod_mask[mask] = prod_mask[mask].multiply(new ModNumberType(1).subtract(prob[left_idx][col]));
                }
            }

            long[] new_bits = new long[N];
            ModNumberType[] new_possible = new ModNumberType[1 << N];
            Arrays.fill(new_possible, new ModNumberType(0));

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumberType> entry : state_map.entrySet()) {
                long mask_state = entry.getKey();
                ModNumberType prob_state = entry.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(new_bits, 0);
                for (int m : count_mask.get(left_idx)) {
                    if (((mask_state >> index_map[m]) & 1) != 0) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((m >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                long new_mask = (long) new_bits[i] | (1L << index_map[m | (1 << i)]);
                                new_bits[i] = new_mask;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Arrays.fill(new_possible, new ModNumberType(0));
                for (int current_mask = 1; current_mask < (1 << N); current_mask++) {
                    int ctz = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current_mask);
                    new_possible[current_mask] = new_possible[current_mask & (current_mask - 1)]
                            .add(new ModNumberType(new_bits[ctz]));
                    long combined_mask = new_possible[current_mask];
                    long combined_mask_value = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                        if (((current_mask >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                            combined_mask_value |= 1L << index_map[(int) new_possible[current_mask].v];
                        }
                    }
                    long combined_mask_final = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                        if (((current_mask >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                            combined_mask_final |= 1L << index_map[(1 << N) - 1];
                        }
                    }
                    long key = combined_mask_final;
                    ModNumberType prev = new_state_map.getOrDefault(key, new ModNumberType(0));
                    new_state_map.put(key, prev.add(prob_state.multiply(prod_mask[current_mask])));
                }
            }
            state_map = new_state_map;
        }

        ModNumberType total = new ModNumberType(0);
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumberType> entry : state_map.entrySet()) {
            long key = entry.getKey();
            if (((key >> index_map[(1 << N) - 1]) & 1) != 0) {
                total = total.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total.v);
    }
}
